petitTaxi.description: Urban taxi within city limits. Uses taximeter. Regulated local fares.
petitTaxi.airportFlatFare: Fixed fare in some cities, e.g., 50–80 MAD from airport to city center
petitTaxi.notes: Fares vary by city. Minimum fare can be higher during nighttime or on weekends.

grandTaxi.description: Shared intercity/suburban taxi. No taximeter. Fixed route and per‑seat pricing.
grandTaxi.perSeatRate: 5–10 MAD for short shared routes, higher for longer distances
grandTaxi.entireVehicleNegotiated: Can be hired privately for a negotiated fare
grandTaxi.airportFixedFare: Official fixed prices for airport routes, typically 50–150 MAD per person depending on destination
grandTaxi.notes: Usually departs when full (6 passengers). Prices are fixed per route and per person.
